configurations.name: build-table-animal
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p .data && (node scripts/build-table.mjs animal > .data/build-table.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> .data/build-table.log) & exec node -e "require('http').createServer((q,s)=>s.end('build-table')).listen(3999)"
